title: The information effects of takeover bids and resistance

context.sample_description: Takeover targets, split into three samples conditioned on ex-post managerial resistance and contest outcome (no resistance, resistance/target acquired, resistance/target remains independent); analysis based on IBES consensus analyst per-share earnings forecast revisions around takeover-bid announcements and contest resolutions

data_sources.name: IBES (Institutional Brokers Estimate System) consensus (mean) earnings forecasts
Sample of takeover event dates classified by ex-post managerial resistance and contest outcome (94 targets, 1979-1984)

dv.name: Revision in consensus FY2 (year-ahead) per-share earnings forecast around bid announcement
dv.source: IBES consensus forecasts; per-share market price

key_ivs.name: Managerial resistance and contest outcome subsample
key_ivs.measure: three samples conditioned on ex-post information: no resistance from target (N=30); resistance/target acquired (n=38); resistance/target remains independent (n=33)

analyses.label: Table 1, Panel B - Nonparametric distribution (% positive / negative / unchanged) of FY2 forecast revisions at bid announcement, by subsample

dv.name: Sign/nonparametric distribution of FY2 forecast revisions at bid announcement
dv.measure: Nonparametric distribution of year-ahead (FY2) earnings-forecast revisions in the month of takeover-bid announcements, tabulated as % positive, % negative, % unchanged, compared with the IBES universe

key_ivs.name: Managerial resistance and contest outcome subsample
key_ivs.measure: no resistance (n=30); resistance/acquired (n=31); resistance/independent (n=33); vs IBES universe benchmark

analyses.label: Table 2 - Forecast revisions during takeover contests (information content of takeover resistance), for resisting targets by contest outcome

dv.name: Revision in consensus FY2 forecast around takeover-contest resolution
dv.source: IBES consensus forecasts; per-share market price

key_ivs.name: Contest outcome for resisting targets
key_ivs.measure: resistance/target acquired (n=31) vs resistance/target remains independent (n=33)

analyses.label: [withheld: wording matches the source]
analyses.sample: 33 targets that defeat takeover bids and remain independent, 1979-1984

dv.name: Mean-squared forecast error (MSFE) of consensus earnings forecasts
dv.source: IBES consensus forecasts; Brown, Foster, and Noreen (1985) IBES universe benchmark

key_ivs.name: Target group (resisting-independent targets vs IBES universe)
key_ivs.measure: targets resisting and remaining independent (n=33), forecasts made 16 months prior to realization, vs IBES universe forecasts made 22 months prior

analyses.label: Cross-sectional regression for ex-post bias of defeat-date consensus target forecasts

dv.name: Ex-post forecast error / bias of defeat-date consensus forecast
dv.measure: cross-sectional regression testing for systematic positive or negative (ex-post) bias in the defeat-date consensus target forecasts; estimated with a correction for heteroskedasticity

key_ivs.measure: per-share forecast/net asset value variables (specific regressors not legible in the OCR text)
